title: Inspect Telegram media exclusions and coverage reporting

identity.source_kind: git archive of exact commit; no Git metadata
identity.reason_remote_unverified: Controller owns host git/fetch; this container is a read-only archive.

findings.fact: Excluded media is reported per event as metadata.media_kind. Health degraded is only dialog listing at MAX_DIALOGS=5000. Media never sets HealthReport.state or detail.
findings.expected: Implementation owners must not treat doctor/health degraded as a media-coverage signal.

findings.fact: A poll or other unreferenced class still becomes a message event with text "" and attachments []. It is not dropped the way a service message is.
findings.expected: Downstream extractors will see empty-text events whose only coverage marker is metadata.media_kind.

findings.fact: describeMedia reads only record.photo.id and record.document.id. Official messageMediaPaidMedia.extended_media, messageMediaInvoice.extended_media, and messageMediaDocument.video_cover are not referenced.
findings.expected: Those constructors name className only, unless a numeric photo/document id happens to sit on the top-level fields.

findings.fact: The wave1 spec still tables per-dialog sensitivity hints and says attachments are excluded from content_hash. Current code labels every Telegram event private and hash v2 includes attachments plus metadata.
findings.expected: P006 owns canonical docs; do not treat the wave1 table as the live contract.
